description: Defines an abstract class Zend_XmlRpc_Value for representing XML-RPC values, including methods for type handling, XML serialization, and parsing XML strings into PHP objects within the Zend Framework.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value
classes.description: Abstract class for XML-RPC value representation, including type management, XML serialization, and parsing functionalities.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the XML-RPC type of the value.

methods.name: getGenerator
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the XML generator, loading the appropriate class based on extension availability.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Changes the encoding of the XML generator.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Abstract method to return the PHP value representation.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Returns the XML serialization of the value, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: generateXml
methods.description: Generates the XML representation of the value.

methods.name: getXmlRpcValue
methods.description: Creates a Zend_XmlRpc_Value object from a PHP variable, XML string, or specified type.

methods.name: getXmlRpcTypeByValue
methods.description: Determines the XML-RPC type for a given PHP variable.

methods.name: _phpVarToNativeXmlRpc
methods.description: Converts a PHP variable into an appropriate Zend_XmlRpc_Value object.

methods.name: _xmlStringToNativeXmlRpc
methods.description: Parses an XML string or SimpleXMLElement into a Zend_XmlRpc_Value object.

methods.name: _createSimpleXMLElement
methods.description: Creates a SimpleXMLElement from a string if necessary.

methods.name: _extractTypeAndValue
methods.description: Extracts the type and value from a SimpleXMLElement.

methods.name: _setXML
methods.description: Sets the internal XML string after stripping the declaration.
